title: Replace current widget with Angel aesthetics image

requirements.summary: Generate an Angel aesthetics image with pure black background and white cursive 'Angel' text in pixelated lo-fi style and save as a static asset
acceptanceCriteria: Image has a solid black background
White cursive/script 'Angel' text is centered on the image
Text has a pixelated/lo-fi aesthetic matching the uploaded reference

file_operations.description: Save the generated Angel aesthetics image with pure black background and white pixelated cursive 'Angel' text to the frontend assets directory at frontend/public/assets/generated/angel-aesthetics.dim_760x428.png

requirements.summary: Replace the existing widget on the Home page with a static image widget displaying the Angel aesthetics image in the same position
acceptanceCriteria: The previous widget is removed from the Home page
The Angel aesthetics image is displayed in the same position as the removed widget
The image renders at an appropriate size consistent with the original widget's footprint
No layout shifts or broken spacing occur around the widget area

file_operations.description: Replace the existing widget component with an img element that displays the generated Angel aesthetics image from frontend/public/assets/generated/angel-aesthetics.dim_760x428.png. Maintain the same layout position and dimensions as the removed widget to prevent any layout shifts. Ensure the image is properly sized and positioned to match the original widget's footprint.
